subject: Follow-up: deployment constraints and next steps (SSO / KMS / logging)
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@fintera.com>, Ben Cho <ben.cho@fintera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro call — deployment constraints recap

Hi Olivia / Ben —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Deployment preference: you indicated strict key control and SSO requirements that are pushing you toward Private (VPC/on-prem) but you're also open to a Dedicated cluster if we can meet KMS/HSM and logging retention controls.

2) SSO: you need SAML2.0 with SCIM provisioning and Okta as the identity provider.

3) KMS/HSM: primary requirement is customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) integrated with an HSM-backed KMS (AWS CloudHSM or Azure Key Vault Managed HSM).

4) Logging / audit: 7+ years of audit log retention and ability to forward immutable logs to your SIEM (Splunk).

5) Network & data residency: production inference must run in us-east-1 VPC with egress controls and no cross-region replication.

Next steps (proposed):
- I'll share a short IT requirements matrix (attached) that maps each item to how Redwood Hosted / Dedicated / Private satisfy it.
- Priyom will put together a Dedicated cost estimate (we discussed reserved pool sizing).
- Marissa will schedule a 45-min technical call with your infra team next week to walk architecture diagrams for Private and Dedicated.

Please confirm that covers everything or add anything I missed.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: fintera_it_requirements.xlsx
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@fintera.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Cho <ben.cho@fintera.com>, Aisha Raman <aisha.raman@fintera.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 17:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Intro call — deployment constraints recap

Hi Rishi —

This is perfect — thanks for the clear summary. A couple of clarifications from our side after syncing with infra: 

- SSO: Okta + SAML2.0 required. SCIM for user provisioning is preferred but could be phased.
- KMS/HSM: We need envelope encryption keys to be customer-managed in our AWS account using CloudHSM; any keys managed by Redwood in your tenancy are a no-go.
- Logging: 7 years retention in our Splunk instance is a hard requirement; we need out-of-band log forwarding (syslog / HTTP) and tamper-evident storage.
- Data plane isolation: if we were to evaluate Dedicated, we need guaranteed single-tenant GPU pools with no shared tenant neighbors.

Procurement note: Aisha (cc'd) will need the pricing breakdown and contract term options.

If you can get the IT matrix, the Dedicated estimate, and the Private architecture doc over early next week we can align infra + procurement for a decision meeting on July 28.

Best,
Olivia
Director, Platform Engineering | Fintera Financial

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@fintera.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Dedicated cost estimate and integration notes

Hi Olivia —

Attached is a preliminary Dedicated estimate (dedicated-cost-estimate-q3.xlsx). High-level summary below: 

- Reserved pool sized for 12 peak concurrent inference workers (based on your estimated QPS).
- Monthly committed spend estimate: $78,400 (includes reserved GPU capacity + base SLA support).
- Add-ons: Private KMS connector (customer-managed key proxy) + extended log forwarding and 7y retention add-on are estimated as one-time integration effort + $3,200/month for archival storage forwarding.

Integration notes: 
- KMS/HSM: We can offer a connector that sits in your VPC to broker key operations against your CloudHSM; it requires a short network onboarding window and an HSM-side service account.
- SSO: SAML + SCIM are supported; for Dedicated we can run the identity sync agents in your VPC for user provisioning and group sync.
- Logging: We will forward signed syslog bundles to your Splunk HEC endpoint and write immutable ledger entries to an AWS S3 bucket in your account for tamper evidence.

I'll be available on Wed to walk through the estimate with procurement.

Thanks,
Priyom
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
